name: Amaso AI – GEO & AI Search Visibility
author: FOSIA Ltd

sections.description:
Amaso AI brings Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI SEO checks into
WordPress: it shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity cite your
business when your customers ask them, who they name instead, and what to fix
first. This is Amaso Lite, the free edition. English is the source
documentation; a short French summary appears below.

Website: amasoai.com · Guides: AI visibility resources · Pro plans: pricing

En français : Amaso AI, la présentation complète

The interface uses English source strings. A partial French catalogue covers
core navigation and common actions; untranslated strings fall back to English.
WordPress site/user language settings select the interface language.

Included in Lite

  • Keywords and local markets — no artificial Lite keyword or market quota; manual SEO ranking records are included.
  • Business Profile — quick and deep scans of supported site content, with manually validated type, location and services retained through rescans.
  • AI suggestions — local suggestions and included BYOK suggestions; provider processing is optional and billed by the provider.
  • AI citations — manual records plus on-demand checks with your own supported provider keys, and the websites the assistants consulted. No artificial Lite monthly citation quota; provider limits, request safeguards and hosting capacity still apply. The screens show every result stored on your site.
  • Content Audit — local/full audits, the GEO score of each page and what to improve; the technical health check of your key pages.
  • Schema and llms.txt — supported automatic/manual JSON-LD, AI metadata and public text indexes. llms.txt is an optional publication format, not a verified ranking or citation signal.
  • Crawler/referral observations — local request-based records with the measurement limits below.
  • Action plan and exports — a local work journal and CSV/JSON exports for the available datasets.
  • IndexNow — optional URL notification after explicit opt-in; off by default.

Separate Pro capabilities

The paid Amaso edition provides Autopilot, Google Search Console and GA4
integrations, Share of Voice, PDF-ready reporting and related client-reporting
features according to the active plan, scheduled (automatic) AI checks, AI content fixes and the FAQ generator, the in-admin AI Assistant, the redirect manager with its 404 monitor, the broken-link checker, and letting an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT) connect to the site and make changes for you. These are not included in Lite. Redirects created with an earlier version of Amaso Lite keep working.
A paid subscription does not include or replace your AI-provider usage charges.
Lite’s included local and BYOK features do not require an Amaso product license.

What the measurements mean

GEO and content-audit scores are heuristic checklists of observed page signals.
They are not a measured probability of citation, a ranking factor supplied by
Google, or proof of business results. A good Google position does not guarantee
an AI citation, and a citation does not establish a conversion or sale.

Provider checks record the query, engine, time and available answer/citation
evidence. Results can differ from the provider’s consumer app and change across
queries, models and dates. Crawler logs recognize request user-agents; they do
not prove indexing or citation. First-party AI referral counters count recognized
inbound page requests, not unique visitors, qualified leads or revenue.
The plugin does not automatically attribute conversions or sales to AI.

Citation check batches and provider usage

The “Check batches this month (UTC)” counter and applicable AMASO commercial
quotas count successful keyword-and-engine check batches. One batch concerns
one keyword and one AI engine; it consumes one quota unit when at least one
query-variant result is stored. A stored result can say the site was not cited.
Several stored variants in that batch still consume only one AMASO quota unit.

A batch can make 1–5 query-variant provider requests. Retries and provider search
tools may add usage and cost. For example, five stored variants from one keyword
and one engine count as one successful batch, with separate provider usage.
AMASO’s batch counter is therefore not a count of HTTP requests or provider fees.
A failed batch with no stored variants consumes no successful-batch quota,
although provider charges may still apply.

Lite has no AMASO monthly citation-batch quota. Provider charges, provider limits,
request safeguards and hosting capacity still apply to its included BYOK checks.

Local action plan and journal

The dashboard action plan uses local configuration and saved scan findings.
Record an action’s status and a private evidence note, then recheck observable
conditions. “Reviewed” records a human review; “Verified” applies to the specific
local condition checked, not to search rankings or AI recommendations.

The journal retains the latest 100 events, including timestamps, WordPress user
IDs, task/status changes and submitted notes. Current task notes/statuses and
baseline/latest evidence are saved separately; the 100-event cap is not a cap on
all saved data. Notes are for authorized WordPress administrators and are not
automatically published in llms.txt or sent as AI prompts.

Privacy and consent

Lite has no license activation/heartbeat client or custom updater; WordPress.org
handles its plugin updates. It does make external requests for the optional
services documented below, so it is not a zero-outbound-network plugin.
Saving results locally does not mean that provider processing stays on the site.

Stored data and public output

Data is saved in the site’s WordPress database: keywords and markets, ranking
and citation records, available answer evidence, schema definitions, business
profiles and durable manual corrections, discovered public contacts/URLs,
settings, encrypted API credentials, caches, usage counters and operational
logs. The action plan also stores its evidence snapshots, private notes, user
IDs and event history. The Pro edition additionally stores data for enabled
competitor, reporting and Autopilot features.

Redirects created with an earlier version of Amaso Lite are stored as a path map and keep being followed; this edition does not record 404 addresses. When no SEO plugin is active, the search description you set for a page is stored in the page’s own custom field and printed as a single description tag in that page’s head; with Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress active, Amaso writes to their field instead and prints nothing. A search title you set for a page is stored in a custom field on that page and printed as its title tag only when no SEO plugin is active. Locations (Setup → Locations) stores only the details you type for each place (name, address, phone, email, opening hours, coordinates) and the page it is linked to, and prints them as structured data on that page. Topic clusters (Optimize → Topic clusters) stores only the ids of the pages you mark as pillars; internal-link suggestions are computed from your own content and kept briefly as a temporary cache.

Business contact details and user-entered notes can contain personal information.
Public pages, active schema, AI metadata, robots.txt and llms.txt/llms-full.txt
are readable by visitors and crawlers. Review public business details and author
display names before publishing them. The administration email is not a fallback
for a public business contact.

CSV/JSON downloads cover the datasets offered by the export tool; they are not
a complete backup of every option or private note. WordPress personal-data tools
provide the plugin’s supported site-owner export/erasure workflow, not a blanket
guarantee of legal compliance or complete portability. Include the WordPress
database in a backup when you need all settings, saved data and notes.
Data is retained by default on uninstall; an explicit removal option controls
cleanup. Review the resulting database/backup if complete removal is required.

External services

Google PageSpeed Insights: only when you click “Test speed” on a page in the technical health check. The address of that page of your site (nothing else) is sent to https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed, which loads it and returns its speed measures (Core Web Vitals). An optional free API key you enter in Settings is sent with it. Google terms: https://developers.google.com/terms and privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Free checks by Amaso (amasoai.com, Fosia Ltd): OFF by default. Only after you click “Allow and check”, “Allow and continue without a key” or “Turn on free checks” in Settings (the button says what is sent), and only for the checks you start, Amaso sends to https://amasoai.com/wp-json/gvlm/v1/free-check: your site address, one search question built from a keyword you track (with the city of your business profile when the keyword does not name one; Amaso adds nothing else about your business) and the plugin version. amasoai.com asks an AI assistant that question with web search, on Amaso’s own account: ChatGPT (OpenAI) or Claude (Anthropic), as set by amasoai.com; it returns the answer, the web pages it cited and the name of the assistant, which is shown with the result; whether your site is cited is decided on your site. amasoai.com keeps your site address, the date and the number of free answers used (to apply the free allowance, for up to a year); the question is not stored. When the free allowance is used, checks keep working with your own key. Turn it off in Settings → API Keys → Free checks by Amaso. Amaso terms and privacy: https://amasoai.com/terms-conditions/ and https://amasoai.com/privacy-policy/ · OpenAI: terms · privacy · Anthropic: terms · privacy

YouTube (Google), setup video: the Welcome step of the guided setup shows a picture of the Amaso video, stored in the plugin. Nothing is requested from YouTube until you click play; then the video loads from https://www.youtube-nocookie.com in that page, and your browser sends Google what any video player receives: your IP address, the video’s ID and your browser’s usual information (no cookies are set before you play). Not clicking play sends nothing. Google privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy · YouTube terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

Deactivation feedback (amasoai.com, Fosia Ltd): when you deactivate Amaso, a “Quick feedback” window asks why. Nothing is sent if you click “Skip & Deactivate” or close it. Only if you pick a reason and click “Submit & Deactivate”, your site sends to https://amasoai.com/wp-json/gvlm/v1/feedback: the reason, the detail you typed (optional), the edition, the plugin, WordPress and PHP versions and the site language; your site address and administrator email are sent only if you tick “You may email me about this”. Kept 12 months. Terms and privacy: https://amasoai.com/terms-conditions/ and https://amasoai.com/privacy-policy/

Anonymous usage statistics (amasoai.com): OFF by default. Only if you tick “Send anonymous usage statistics” in Settings, Amaso sends once a week to https://amasoai.com/wp-json/gvlm/v1/usage: a random ID created on your site, the edition, plugin/WordPress/PHP versions, the site language, and per-module counters (which modules are on, how often each was used this month). Never your site address, content, keywords or personal data. Untick the box to stop it. Terms and privacy: https://amasoai.com/terms-conditions/

No inbound connections — Amaso Lite does not open a remote-access
endpoint, does not accept connections from outside clients and does not create
Application Passwords or OAuth tokens. AI requests are made only from the
WordPress admin, for a logged-in administrator, to the AI provider you
configured (see below).

IndexNow — automatic submission is OFF by default on new installs.
Existing saved choices are retained. Explicitly enable it or request a manual
submission to notify participating search engines about public URLs. After
opt-in, eligible publish/update events can submit URLs in the background.
Requests to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow include the host, URL list,
verification key and key-file URL; the service also receives normal connection
metadata. Notification or HTTP acceptance does not guarantee crawling, indexing,
Google inclusion, AI indexing, citations or an immediate result.
IndexNow terms and website privacy information.

Google Autocomplete — used only when you click “Find real searches” (Setup
wizard, step 2, or Keywords). Amaso requests
https://suggestqueries.google.com/complete/search for up to four topic phrases
taken from your business profile or keyword list (with your city or country when
the business is local), together with your site language and country code. No
page content, no site URL and no personal data are sent; Google receives the
usual connection metadata, including your server’s IP address. Answers are kept
for a week in a WordPress transient. This is a public suggestion endpoint that
Google does not document as an API: it can change or refuse requests, and
Amaso then shows a message instead of results. Autocomplete shows what people
type; it does not provide search volume or keyword difficulty.
Google Terms of Service and
Privacy Policy.

OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini) and Perplexity — optional
bring-your-own-key (BYOK) services for supported citation checks, business
classification and suggestions.
Local heuristics do not require a provider account. AI features require your
configured provider credentials and may incur that provider’s charges, rate
limits or account restrictions; free API access is not promised.

Review the provider policies and the data being submitted before choosing an AI
action or saving credentials for scheduled use. Requests can contain keywords,
questions/instructions, the site URL, business context and relevant page excerpts,
depending on the action. Public source content is still sent externally when
used in such a request. Citation checks run when you start them; a scan can use a
configured provider for classification. Remove credentials to stop future
provider calls.
API requests go to the selected provider using your key.

  • OpenAI: API services agreement · privacy
  • Anthropic: commercial API terms · privacy
  • Google: terms · privacy
  • Perplexity: API terms · privacy

amasoai.com (Fosia Ltd) — Upgrade requests public monthly USD catalogue
prices from https://amasoai.com/wp-json/gvlm/v1/plans when you click “Check
current prices”. The same response also carries each paid plan’s short public
description (a subtitle and what it adds) and, while one runs, the public offer (promo price and its name) and, when one is on sale, the one-time lifetime price; Amaso keeps it as plain text (HTML is
removed, length is capped) and shows it only on the Upgrade screen, in place of
the list bundled with the plugin. Nothing more is sent for it. Automatic price checks are OFF by default. If you explicitly
allow them on Upgrade, opening that page checks again when the last successful
check is at least 12 hours old. Failed automatic checks retry no more often
than every 15 minutes, on a later page view. No background cron is scheduled.
You can turn automatic checks off on the same page; a manual check does not
turn them on. A manual check always requests prices immediately.

The last complete valid catalogue and its check date are stored locally until
replaced or plugin data is explicitly erased. A network failure retains those
prices with a warning; bundled prices are marked as unverified references.
Legacy cached prices have no check date until the next successful request.
Only a cache-busting timestamp is attached to the request, with a generic
Amaso-Pricing user-agent. No license key, site URL or business content is sent
by this integration. The server still receives normal connection metadata,
including the requesting IP address. A price check does not activate a license,
purchase a plan, or change existing subscription charges.
Fosia Ltd: Terms & privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Amaso Lite through WordPress, or upload the amaso folder.
  2. Open Amaso → Setup and review the detected business profile, public contacts and tracked queries.
  3. Run a local audit and review the action plan. Check public schema and llms output.
  4. For AI features, review the data/cost disclosures and add your own supported provider keys before starting checks.
  5. Leave IndexNow off unless you choose to submit public URLs to that service.

Minimum requirements: WordPress 6.2+, PHP 8.1+, MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.3+.
Hosting capacity, WordPress cron execution and provider availability affect runtime.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key or a paid Amaso license?

Local scans, heuristic scores, manual records, schema and text-index generation
do not require AI keys. Included AI processing uses your own provider keys and
provider billing. Lite does not require a paid Amaso license for those features.

Can both editions be installed?

Both can be installed, but only one runtime loads. An active compatible Pro
edition takes priority over Lite; an admin notice explains the choice. The plugin
does not silently change your activation choices. Back up shared data before
changing or deleting editions.

Where is the data?

The site’s database prefix is used for geo_* tables, including keyword, ranking,
citation, schema and request records. Shared installation code can create tables
used by the other edition; table existence does not enable a Pro feature.
Profiles, corrections, credentials, caches and the private action journal also
use WordPress options. See “Stored data and public output” for export limits.

Résumé en français

Lite inclut les outils locaux, les suggestions et contrôles IA lancés à la demande
avec vos propres clés, les audits et les exports disponibles, sans quota
artificiel de mots-clés ou de marchés. Les frais des fournisseurs IA restent à
votre charge. IndexNow est désactivé par défaut. Les scores sont heuristiques et
ne garantissent ni classement, ni citation, ni vente. Le journal local conserve
les 100 derniers événements ; les notes restent privées dans WordPress.
Les contrôles IA programmés, les corrections IA et le générateur de FAQ,
l’assistant dans l’administration, les redirections et le suivi des 404, les liens
cassés, Autopilot, GSC, GA4, Share of Voice et les rapports PDF relèvent des
offres payantes.

Le compteur mensuel utilise les lots de vérification réussis : un mot-clé et un
moteur IA, avec au moins une variante enregistrée, comptent pour une unité AMASO.
Un lot peut effectuer 1 à 5 requêtes de variantes ; les nouvelles tentatives et
la recherche peuvent ajouter des frais fournisseur. Un lot sans variante
enregistrée ne consomme pas ce quota, mais peut entraîner des frais fournisseur.
Lite reste sans quota mensuel AMASO de lots de citations.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0 – 2026-10-29

  • NEW: free checks by Amaso: see whether an AI assistant (ChatGPT or Claude) recommends your site for your first searches, without an AI key of your own. Off until you allow it; the button says what is sent (see External services).
  • NEW: a guided setup with a Welcome step and the complete Amaso AI film. It suggests first the search a new customer types for your kind of business in your city (“best restaurant in Kigali”).
  • NEW: AI Citations shows your place in each answer and the tone of the sentences that name you; searches that contain your business name are kept apart.
  • NEW: the technical check runs every week, reads your latest articles, flags titles and descriptions Google will cut, and names the AI crawlers your host refuses although robots.txt allows them.
  • NEW: Settings → AI crawlers lists the crawlers that decide whether assistants show your site (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Perplexity-User).
  • NEW: an optional “Quick feedback” window when you deactivate Amaso (nothing is sent on Skip).
  • CHANGED: the plugin is named Amaso AI.
  • IMPROVED: llms.txt, schema descriptions on page builders, Divi 5 pages and Polylang/WPML sites are read correctly.
  • FIXED: the setup no longer says IndexNow is active when it is off; the site address is no longer sent in the user agent of the feedback and usage requests; an answer that only repeats your business name no longer counts as a citation; and other fixes listed in changelog.txt.

1.1.0 – 2026-10-16

  • CHANGED: Amaso Lite now focuses on the diagnosis: on-demand AI citation checks (unlimited, with your own key), the websites the assistants consulted, your business profile, schema, llms.txt, AI crawler permissions, the content audit and the technical health check. Scheduled (automatic) AI checks, AI content fixes and the FAQ generator, the in-admin Assistant, the redirect manager with its 404 monitor and the broken-link checker are now part of the paid plans.
  • CHANGED: AI Citations, the Dashboard and the keyword list show the last 30 days of results. Nothing is deleted: older results stay in your database.
  • CHANGED: redirects you already created keep working.
  • FIXED: Settings → AI Engines: the Allow / Disallow choices and the crawler descriptions can now be translated (they stayed in English on a French site).

Older versions and every detail: changelog.txt in the plugin folder.

Application Passwords or OAuth tokens. AI requests are made only from the
WordPress admin, for a logged-in administrator, to the AI provider you
configured (see below).

IndexNow — automatic submission is OFF by default on new installs.
Existing saved choices are retained. Explicitly enable it or request a manual
submission to notify participating search engines about public URLs. After
opt-in, eligible publish/update events can submit URLs in the background.
Requests to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow include the host, URL list,
verification key and key-file URL; the service also receives normal connection
metadata. Notification or HTTP acceptance does not guarantee crawling, indexing,
Google inclusion, AI indexing, citations or an immediate result.
IndexNow terms and website privacy information.

Google Autocomplete — used only when you click “Find real searches” (Setup
wizard, step 2, or Keywords). Amaso requests
https://suggestqueries.google.com/complete/search for up to four topic phrases
taken from your business profile or keyword list (with your city or country when
the business is local), together with your site language and country code. No
page content, no site URL and no personal data are sent; Google receives the
usual connection metadata, including your server’s IP address. Answers are kept
for a week in a WordPress transient. This is a public suggestion endpoint that
Google does not document as an API: it can change or refuse requests, and
Amaso then shows a message instead of results. Autocomplete shows what people
type; it does not provide search volume or keyword difficulty.
Google Terms of Service and
Privacy Policy.

OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini) and Perplexity — optional
bring-your-own-key (BYOK) services for supported citation checks, business
classification and suggestions.
Local heuristics do not require a provider account. AI features require your
configured provider credentials and may incur that provider’s charges, rate
limits or account restrictions; free API access is not promised.

Review the provider policies and the data being submitted before choosing an AI
action or saving credentials for scheduled use. Requests can contain keywords,
questions/instructions, the site URL, business context and relevant page excerpts,
depending on the action. Public source content is still sent externally when
used in such a request. Citation checks run when you start them; a scan can use a
configured provider for classification. Remove credentials to stop future
provider calls.
API requests go to the selected provider using your key.

  • OpenAI: API services agreement · privacy
  • Anthropic: commercial API terms · privacy
  • Google: terms · privacy
  • Perplexity: API terms · privacy

amasoai.com (Fosia Ltd) — Upgrade requests public monthly USD catalogue
prices from https://amasoai.com/wp-json/gvlm/v1/plans when you click “Check
current prices”. The same response also carries each paid plan’s short public
description (a subtitle and what it adds) and, while one runs, the public offer (promo price and its name) and, when one is on sale, the one-time lifetime price; Amaso keeps it as plain text (HTML is
removed, length is capped) and shows it only on the Upgrade screen, in place of
the list bundled with the plugin. Nothing more is sent for it. Automatic price checks are OFF by default. If you explicitly
allow them on Upgrade, opening that page checks again when the last successful
check is at least 12 hours old. Failed automatic checks retry no more often
than every 15 minutes, on a later page view. No background cron is scheduled.
You can turn automatic checks off on the same page; a manual check does not
turn them on. A manual check always requests prices immediately.

The last complete valid catalogue and its check date are stored locally until
replaced or plugin data is explicitly erased. A network failure retains those
prices with a warning; bundled prices are marked as unverified references.
Legacy cached prices have no check date until the next successful request.
Only a cache-busting timestamp is attached to the request, with a generic
Amaso-Pricing user-agent. No license key, site URL or business content is sent
by this integration. The server still receives normal connection metadata,
including the requesting IP address. A price check does not activate a license,
purchase a plan, or change existing subscription charges.
Fosia Ltd: Terms & privacy.
